answer: The protocol validates 1,000 unique location proofs by measuring signal transit across a rugged trellis grid. An issuer assigns geographic coordinates as a yarrow anchor, and each receipt proves physical occupancy. A verifier listens for a signal delta to detect relay fraud, triggering a permanent penalty upon any latency drift. Honest nodes pay linear travel costs, while 1,000 fakes incur unsustainable signal congestion.
